pass_a_gloss: Demons' table refused; fortune-cup portioned shame; new wine with Christ; Son confessed.
pass_b_english: But if any, from much love of life, yield and taste the demons' table — 'ye cannot drink the Lord's cup and demons' cup; ye cannot share the Lord's table and demons' table' — remember Isaiah: 'Ye who forsake the Lord, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for the demon and fill a fortune-cup' (1 Corinthians 10:21) — what portion awaits? 'Ye shall eat, but be hungry; drink, but thirst; my servants shall rejoice, but ye be ashamed.' (Isaiah 65:11–15) 'I am the vine' — drink the new wine with Christ in the Father's kingdom, not the fortune-cup with demons. 'He that denieth the Son hath neither the Father; he that confesseth the Son hath the Father also.' (Matthew 26:29) (1 John 2:22–23)
